subject: Quarter-end pulse: budget & timeline for inference rollout
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@heliosdata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood + Helios Data

Hi Lena (and team),

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum into the quarter close: 

Key priorities you shared:
- <15ms p95 generation for 2k concurrent sessions (US + EU).
- Data isolation for defined customer segments (no shared-tenancy for PII).
- Auditability: request logs and short retention windows for dev/test.

What we’re proposing next:
1) Mutual Action Plan — I attached a draft (MAP-Helios.xlsx) that lays out milestones, owners, and target dates.
2) Compliance docs — attached a SOC2 summary and our standard data handling overview (Helios-Discovery-Recap.pdf).
3) Technical deep-dive — Monica (cc) can run a 60-min infra session to validate throughput/latency assumptions.

Can you confirm the internal approver and whether the June budget cycle (end of month) is still the decision milestone? If yes, we’ll prioritize an indicative pricing pack and an accelerated PO path.

Proposed next steps: a) review MAP, b) book a 60-min deep-dive with Monica (I’ll propose slots once I hear back), c) procurement looped for indicative pricing.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if that helps.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Helios-Discovery-Recap.pdf (summary), MAP-Helios.xlsx (draft mutual action plan)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@heliosdata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Helios Procurement <procurement@heliosdata.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood + Helios Data

Jonas — thanks for the recap and materials. I’m running this by our engineering lead and procurement this week. A couple quick asks: 

- Can you share an indicative pricing range (order-of-magnitude) for the configuration we discussed (2x A100 equiv, multi-region routing, prefix caching)? Procurement is cc’d.
- Is the MAP flexible on timing? Our procurement window is tight — budget sign-off expected late June, but there is a chance it slips into early July depending on a vendor consolidation discussion.

I’ll aim to get a decision timeline by Friday. If procurement needs a tighter deadline for a PO, let me know so we can prioritize.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product, Helios Data
Lena.Oritz@heliosdata.com

Lena — attaching a short indicative pricing pack (Redwood-Indicative-Pricing.pdf) that maps to three configs: entry, production, and high-availability (multi-region). High level: 
- Entry: $8k–$12k/month (minimal replication, aggressive caching).
- Production: $25k–$40k/month (dedicated capacity + SLOs).
- HA / Global: $60k+/month (multi-region + reserved throughput).

Those ranges are ballpark until we lock sequence-length and token-rate assumptions during the Monica deep-dive.

Monica — can you propose two 60-min slots this week for the infra session? Lena — also including a Calendly link if you prefer self-scheduling: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min.

If budget sign-off is still aiming for late June, we can prioritize an accelerated PO and put provisioning on the critical path. If you expect a July decision, we’ll keep the MAP timeline flexible. Either way, please confirm the approver and any contract constraints procurement needs to see (data residency language, approved sub-processors).

Thanks,
Jonas

Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter-end pulse: budget & timeline for inference rollout

Hi Lena — quick nudge as we approach month-end. Wanted to check whether the budget/approval timing you mentioned is still the plan, or if Helios’ internal priorities shifted since we last spoke. 

A few short notes: 
- If you’re still targeting a late-June sign-off, we can queue expedited provisioning and prioritize your production slots.
- If the decision has slipped to July, that’s fine — we’ll keep the MAP dates flexible and recommend a minimal reserved window to hold pricing.
- If there are blockers (legal language or procurement docs), please flag them and I’ll have Rishi (cc) coordinate with our GTM/legal team.

Would you be available for a 15-min pulse call tomorrow (quick alignment) or early next week? I’ve included proposed times in the Calendly link and can send an invite once you pick a slot.

Appreciate a quick reply — even a one-line status is helpful for planning.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
